description: The Three Gorges study deposit supplies hydrological-station measurements used in flood-propagation and sediment-transport simulation. This resource is provided by Bangwen Zhang. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The description does not identify stations, time coverage or the complete numerical setup. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
